description: AstraFlare is a multidisciplinary team brought together by a shared interest in solving meaningful challenges through research, technology, design and collaboration. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we are taking on a challenge that demands both scientific thinking and creative problem solving. Our team works by questioning assumptions, combining different strengths, and refining ideas until they become clear, useful and impactful. We value curiosity, teamwork and the courage to explore difficult problems in new ways.
